notes.title: MUTANT COLLEGE IS RELEASING NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!!
We are excited to announce that Mutant College has just been released! We can't wait to share with you the result of this incredible journey.

In a world where 0.003% of the global population possesses mutant powers, attending a college for superheroes could be the opportunity of a lifetime—will you seize it? Mutant College is an adult visual novel that will immerse you in unique, thrilling, and engaging erotic experiences!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297278/d67a897671ce43a4796af365660cf59d9ef9daed.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for your support.

Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291310/Mutant_College/]wishlist[/url] on Steam and get ready for an amazing adventure!

notes.title: Mutant College: my next game is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Many of you have asked for information about my new project, so here I am, sharing a few details about Mutant College:

Mutant College will be a much larger game compared to Criminal Attraction and Mech Academy. First of all, there will be many more girls to develop relationships with—around 15. Each one, of course, has her own personality, desires, and kinks. Given the scale of the story and environments, I’ve decided to manage everything with a sandbox. I know what you’re thinking: “sandbox = grinding.” Absolutely not. The sandbox will be set up so that the gameplay and story are never slow or boring—trust me!

As for the story: you’ll live an adventure in the shoes of a mutant who has only recently discovered his powers. He finds himself attending Mutant College and, as tradition goes, every girl he meets will fall at his feet :). Mutant College won’t just let you experience a series of erotic adventures—a captivating underlying story will tie events together throughout. The MC will see his power grow to the point where he’ll have the potential to become a true hero.

The Steam page is already up! If you like the idea and want to support the development, add it to your wishlist—it will help me a lot to gauge your interest.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291310/Mutant_College/]STEAM PAGE[/url]

Thank you all so much for the support you’ve given me over the years. None of this would be possible without you!

notes.title: Criminal Attraction releasing in 2 days!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!!
I am pleased to announce that my other game Criminal Attraction will be released in 2 days! 
I wanted to tell you that the game will be released complete and not in early access, in fact it has 100,000 words, 3500 pictures and 100 videos.

You are a cunning FBI agent. Four beautiful girls are robbing banks. Infiltrate their gang and let yourself be carried away by your feelings towards them. Love? Hate? Passion? Lust? Find the evidence to frame them and send them to jail, or, fall in love with them!

I hope you will enjoy the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633270/8048cc5936dd059d1984b6a2e4bfa8a31a9fe1ee.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Intruder on the Bridge - Cully
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the new DLC 'Intruder on the Bridge: Cully' has been released!  

In this new free-to-play DLC the main character is Lieutenant Cully Conner.
Cully tells her story, her relationship with Mannheimer and what makes her who she is.
This DLC contains over 200 seconds of video and animations, 430 new images and about 8000 words. During the dialogues the player will be able to change some details of the story.
The player will be able to unlock 10 new achievements.

Add DLC to your list now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060430/Intruder_on_the_bridge__Cully]here[/url].

Keep following us for new content!

notes.title: HOT FIX! V1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]HOT FIX![/h1]
[h2]V1.0.3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045352/62a7a72a0302488df4dd050caa3344c7049adfd5.png[/img]

We are happy to see that you appreciate our product so much. We are working on an update that will solve any problem our users may have found including problems with Russian, French, Korean languages, problems with interaction with some game features, problems with some graphics. 

We thank you for yours attention to detail and yours reports and we have taken them into consideration, in fact we have fixed the following problems:

-We have fixed all kinds of bugs in the French and Spanish languages.

-We realize that Captain Dyce's body is not the same in all scenes. We have fixed some discrepancies between game images with new renderings.

-We have added a 'back' button in the pause menu for a smoother UI(However you can press the 'backspace' key as a 'back' function).

-Fixed a bug for which it was very complicated to seduce Miranda Call in her final scene.

-We recognize that in the FPS minigame there is an inconsistency with the VN regarding the location of Captain Dyce's weapon. We believed this could be a 'non-sense' fact that would not create problems in gameplay. Thanks to yours report we placed the weapon in the character's inventory and no longer collectible. We have also made the UI of the minigame more intuitive.
